svg.title: 03 · StudySpace
svg.desc: StudySpace (Web app): A private study space for two, with an AI tutor and a sky that fills with stars. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Gemini API. Has a live demo.
